LionDesk Alternative

Your CRM can be deleted by someone else’s boardroom. A Google Sheet can’t be sunset.

Looking for a LionDesk alternative after the shutdown? OneBizOS Realtor Business OS gives you the CRM, pipeline and follow-up system LionDesk users lost — except it lives in your own Google Drive, costs $49 once, and no company can ever switch it off on you.

What happened to LionDesk

As reported by Inman and HousingWire, Lone Wolf Technologies discontinued LionDesk on 30 September 2025. Agents who had built years of contacts, pipelines and follow-up history inside it were given a deadline to export their data and move — whether they were ready or not. Reports put the number of displaced agents at roughly 165,000, a figure reported by Prospeo.

Nothing about that story is unusual. Software companies get acquired, products get merged, and the smaller product gets an end-of-life email. The only unusual part is how many agents it happened to at once.

The real lesson: rented software can be taken back

When your CRM lives on someone else’s servers, your business history is a guest in their building. Prices can rise, features can move behind higher tiers, and — as LionDesk users learned — the whole building can be demolished on a schedule set in a boardroom you will never sit in.

A system built inside Google Sheets works differently. The file is in your Drive, under your Google account. There is no server of ours to shut down, no subscription to lapse, and no boardroom that can vote your follow-up list out of existence.

The alternative: OneBizOS Realtor Business OS

  • CRM + pipeline in one sheet — every lead, viewing, deal and commission in a single connected workspace.
  • Follow-ups that flag themselves — due dates turn AMBER today and RED when overdue, so no lead quietly goes cold.
  • $49 once — no subscription — lifetime updates and basic support included. One payment, and the system is yours.
  • Your data stays yours — delivered into your own Google workspace, with unlimited tables as your records grow.

Start free, then decide

You do not have to take our word for any of this. The follow-up engine inside OneBizOS is available on its own as a free tracker — one sheet, your Drive, no card. Use it for a week. If a free sheet already beats what you had, imagine the full system.

Real Estate CRM in Google Sheets

A real estate CRM in Google Sheets: your whole business in one sheet.

No new app to learn, no subscription to feed. A Google Sheets CRM puts your leads, pipeline and money in one place — a file you already know how to use, that lives in your own Drive and opens on any device.

The idea, simply

A CRM is just three questions answered at a glance: Who are my leads? Where is each deal? When do I next follow up? Most software wraps those questions in dashboards, logins and monthly fees. A well-built Google Sheet answers them in tabs: one for your leads (the CRM), one that moves deals stage by stage (the pipeline), and one that tracks the money (cashflow and commissions) — all connected, so you update once and everything agrees.

Why agents end up in Sheets

  • Zero learning curve — if you can type in a spreadsheet, you already know this CRM.
  • It is yours — the file sits in your Google Drive. No company can sunset it, raise its rent, or hold it hostage.
  • It works everywhere — phone in the car, laptop at the office, the same live sheet.
  • No per-user pricing — a sheet does not bill you again for every person who opens it.

Start with the Lite idea: the follow-up tracker

The simplest useful version of a Sheets CRM is a single follow-up tracker: one row per lead, a column for the next follow-up date, and colors that do the remembering — AMBER when a follow-up is due today, RED when it is overdue. That one tab fixes the most expensive problem in real estate: leads lost to forgotten follow-ups. It is exactly why we give that tracker away free.

When you outgrow one tab, the full OneBizOS Realtor Business OS is the same idea grown up: dashboard, CRM, pipeline, tasks, WhatsApp follow-up, cashflow, commissions and reports — still one Google Sheet system, still yours, still $49 once.

Real Estate Lead Tracking Spreadsheet

The real estate lead tracking spreadsheet that never lets a follow-up slip.

Most agents do not have a lead problem — they have a follow-up problem. Here is the simple spreadsheet method that fixes it: one row per lead, one date that matters, and colors that nag so you do not have to remember.

Step 1: the columns (keep it to these)

  • Lead name & phone — who they are and how to reach them in one tap.
  • Buyer or seller, and source — so you know what they want and where they came from.
  • Last contact — the date you last actually spoke, not the date you meant to.
  • Next follow-up — the single most important column on the sheet (see Step 2).
  • Status — a simple dropdown: new, in conversation, viewing booked, offer, closed, cold.

Step 2: the one rule — every row always has a date

Every conversation ends the same way: before you close the sheet, the lead gets a next follow-up date. No date means the lead is invisible, and invisible leads are the ones that buy from someone else. A lead without a next step is not “being nurtured” — it is being forgotten, politely.

Step 3: let colors do the nagging — AMBER today, RED overdue

Now the sheet starts working for you. Format the follow-up column so a date that is due today turns AMBER, and a date that has slipped past turns RED. Your morning routine becomes ten seconds long: open the sheet, call the AMBERs, rescue the REDs. No reminders to set, no app notifications to configure — the color is the system.

Doing the conditional formatting by hand is fiddly, which is why our free tracker ships with all of it built in — the columns, the dropdowns and the AMBER/RED rules, ready in your own Drive.

Skip the setup. Take the finished tracker — free.

The OneBizOS Lite Follow-Up Tracker is this exact method, already built: columns, dropdowns, AMBER/RED dates and a START HERE tab. Free forever, in your own Google Drive.
